segments.text: Nine Test hundreds. No Indian wicketkeeper has more.
segments.caption: Nine Test hundreds. No Indian wicketkeeper has more.

segments.text: MS Dhoni made six, in ninety Tests. Rishabh Pant has nine, in fifty-three.
segments.caption: MS Dhoni made six, in 90 Tests. Rishabh Pant has nine, in 53.

segments.text: But the hundreds aren't what make him different.
segments.caption: But the hundreds aren't what make him different.

segments.text: Line up India's great keepers. Farokh Engineer, two hundreds in forty-six Tests. Syed Kirmani, two in eighty-eight.
segments.caption: Line up India's great keepers. Farokh Engineer, two hundreds in 46 Tests. Syed Kirmani, two in 88.

segments.text: Wriddhiman Saha, three in forty. Dhoni, six in ninety.
segments.caption: Wriddhiman Saha, three in 40. Dhoni, six in 90.

segments.text: Pant makes a hundred every six Tests. Dhoni made one every fifteen.
segments.caption: Pant makes a hundred every six Tests. Dhoni made one every fifteen.

segments.text: Now the world. Every dot is a leading keeper, placed by average and strike rate.
segments.caption: Now the world. Every dot is a leading keeper, placed by average and strike rate.

segments.text: Most sit here: averaging in the thirties, scoring fifty or sixty runs per hundred balls.
segments.caption: Most sit here: averaging in the thirties, scoring fifty or sixty runs per hundred balls.

segments.text: Pant sits up here. Almost forty-five, at seventy-four. On this chart, only Adam Gilchrist is higher and faster: forty-seven, at eighty-two.
segments.caption: Pant sits up here. Almost 45, at 74. On this chart, only Adam Gilchrist is higher and faster: 47, at 82.

segments.text: Here's what really sets him apart. Compare each keeper with the top-order batters in his own team.
segments.caption: Here's what really sets him apart. Compare each keeper with the top-order batters in his own team.

segments.text: Watling and Saha scored slower than theirs. Dhoni, six runs per hundred balls faster.
segments.caption: Watling and Saha scored slower than theirs. Dhoni, six runs per hundred balls faster.

segments.text: Pant is twenty-five faster. At Edgbaston, with India ninety-eight for five, he made one hundred and forty-six off one hundred and eleven balls.
segments.caption: Pant is 25 faster. At Edgbaston, with India 98 for 5, he made 146 off 111 balls.

segments.text: He doesn't fit into a team's tempo. He changes it.
segments.caption: He doesn't fit into a team's tempo. He changes it.

segments.text: And he does it with sixes. A hundred and eight, the most by any wicketkeeper in Test history. Gilchrist hit a hundred.
segments.caption: And he does it with sixes. 108, the most by any wicketkeeper in Test history. Gilchrist hit 100.

segments.text: At home, he averages almost fifty, and against spin he scores at almost a run a ball. Away, he averages almost forty-three. Dhoni averaged thirty-three away from home.
segments.caption: At home, he averages almost 50, and against spin he scores at almost a run a ball. Away, he averages almost 43. Dhoni averaged 33 away from home.

segments.text: Since 2002, India's other keepers have three away hundreds between them. Pant has seven, all in SENA countries, one in each of them. Dhoni never made one there.
segments.caption: Since 2002, India's other keepers have three away hundreds between them. Pant has seven, all in SENA countries, one in each of them. Dhoni never made one there.

segments.text: Now, the hard part. When he walks in with four down for under a hundred and fifty, Pant averages thirty-four. De Kock and Watling do better.
segments.caption: Now, the hard part. When he walks in with four down for under 150, Pant averages 34. De Kock and Watling do better.

segments.text: But watch the fourth innings, when Tests are decided. A hundred and fourteen at the Oval. Ninety-seven at Sydney, to save a Test. Eighty-nine not out at the Gabba, to win one. Sixty-four at Mumbai, when the rest of the innings added fifty-seven.
segments.caption: But watch the fourth innings, when Tests are decided. 114 at the Oval. 97 at Sydney, to save a Test. 89 not out at the Gabba, to win one. 64 at Mumbai, when the rest of the innings added 57.

segments.text: In fourth innings, he averages forty-one. Dhoni averaged thirty-three.
segments.caption: In fourth innings, he averages 41. Dhoni averaged 33.

segments.text: And in Tests India lose, Pant still averages thirty-nine. Dhoni averaged twenty-seven. No keeper here fights harder in defeat.
segments.caption: And in Tests India lose, Pant still averages 39. Dhoni averaged 27. No keeper here fights harder in defeat.

segments.text: So, is he India's greatest keeper-batter? By hundreds, by tempo, by what he does away from home, nobody else is close.
segments.caption: So, is he India's greatest keeper-batter? By hundreds, by tempo, by what he does away from home, nobody else is close.
